blocks.title: Enterprise Protection and Analytics exam shortcuts
items: Critical system file changes unexpectedly → FIM
File integrity monitoring detects changes to protected files or configurations.
Example: An alert fires when a system binary is modified.
Sensitive data is leaving through email or USB → DLP
Example: A file containing SSNs is blocked from upload.
Unmanaged or noncompliant device attempts connection → NAC
Check policy before granting network access.
Example: An unpatched laptop is quarantined instead of joining the production LAN.
Investigate and contain activity on the endpoint.
Example: EDR isolates a laptop and shows the malicious process tree.
Attack spans endpoint + email + identity → XDR
Correlate signals across multiple security domains.
Example: Phishing email, suspicious login, and endpoint malware become one incident.
User suddenly downloads thousands of sensitive files → USER BEHAVIOR ANALYTICS
Compare behavior against the user's normal baseline.
Example: An unusual bulk-download pattern triggers investigation.
blocks.example: Focus on what needs to be changed: traffic rules, detection logic, protocol choice, filtering policy, endpoint response, or user-behavior controls.

questions.q: A protected system binary changes unexpectedly and the security team needs an alert. Which control is most appropriate?
questions.explanation: File integrity monitoring detects unexpected file or configuration changes.

questions.q: A company wants to block employees from copying sensitive customer data to USB drives. Which control is best?
questions.explanation: DLP prevents unauthorized movement or disclosure of sensitive data.

questions.q: An unmanaged laptop should be denied production-network access until it meets security requirements. Which control is most appropriate?
questions.explanation: NAC evaluates user or device conditions before granting network access.

questions.q: A workstation shows malicious behavior and needs to be isolated while analysts inspect its process tree. Which capability is best?
questions.explanation: EDR focuses on endpoint detection, investigation, containment, and response.

questions.q: A phishing email, suspicious cloud login, and endpoint malware should be correlated into one incident. Which capability is designed for this?
questions.explanation: XDR correlates telemetry and response across multiple security domains.

questions.q: A user who normally downloads a few files suddenly downloads thousands of sensitive records. Which control is most appropriate?
questions.explanation: User behavior analytics detects deviations from a user's normal behavior.
